issues.title: 产品灵感日报 · 20 个新品

products.name: Solid
products.tagline: Agents with their own computers, accounts, and budgets.
products.summaryZh: 拥有自己电脑、账户和预算的代理。
products.descriptionZh: Solid 的 AI 代理能构建应用、自动化工作流，并处理你无暇或缺乏专业能力完成的工作。它们会自行挑选并配置真实的机器，创建账户并支付服务费用。它们通过 API 使用你的应用，或像人一样登录。它们会构建缺失的部分，并在此过程中解决问题。不妨超越 Grok Bot 和 Muse 这类个人代理：Solid 为你和你的团队打造，专为复杂、长期运行的工作而设计。合上你的笔记本电脑。Solid 从头到尾负责这项工作。
products.description: Solid’s AI agents build apps, automate workflows and tackle work you lack the time or expertise for. They pick and set up their own real machines, create accounts and pay for services. They use your apps through APIs or log in like a person. They build what’s missing and fix problems along the way. Think beyond personal agents like Grok Bot and Muse: Solid is built for complex, long-running work for you and your team. Close your laptop. Solid owns the job from start to finish.

products.name: Naise AI
products.tagline: Autonomous marketing agents that actually execute
products.summaryZh: 真正执行任务的自主营销代理
products.descriptionZh: 别再为AI空白的文本框操心。Naise AI为创始人和精简团队提供完整营销部门的产出，却无需承担相应的人力成本。通过持久记忆锁定品牌规范，选择提示词手册，让平台负责执行。从筛选真实影响者、向记者推介，到原生生成并排期社交内容。从冷启动到上线营销活动，不到24小时，每周节省40多个小时，降低营销成本。
products.description: Stop babysitting AI's empty text boxes. Naise AI gives founders and lean teams the output of a full marketing department without the overhead. Lock in your brand guidelines with Persistent Memory, select an Prompt Playbook, and let the platform handle the execution. From vetting real influencers and pitching to journalists, to generating and scheduling social content natively. Go from a cold start to live campaigns in under 24 hours, saving 40+ hours a week and cutting your marketing costs.

products.name: Claude Opus 5.5
products.tagline: Anthropic's first model in their new Claude 5.5 family
products.summaryZh: Anthropic 全新 Claude 5.5 系列的首款模型
products.descriptionZh: Claude Opus 5.5 是 Anthropic 面向智能体编程与知识工作的最新模型，带来显著的性能提升、更清晰的沟通、更强的安全性，并在典型工作负载下比 Opus 5 成本降低 40%。
products.description: Claude Opus 5.5 is Anthropic’s latest model for agentic coding and knowledge work, delivering major performance gains, clearer communication, stronger safety, and 40% lower cost than Opus 5 on typical workloads.

products.name: Pactto
products.tagline: The room where creative teams align and AI takes action
products.summaryZh: 创意团队协同、AI 行动的房间
products.descriptionZh: Pactto 是一个全新的 AI 平台，专为创意团队打造，能以工作室级品质展示作品，借助理解创意意图的 AI 代理协助审阅素材，记录每一条意见，并可实时进行修改。与 Zoom 或 Google Meet 不同——通话结束后上下文便随之消失——Pactto 房间会记住一切。每一次对话、每一个决定、每一条反馈。
products.description: Pactto is a new AI platform for creative teams to present work at studio quality, review assets assisted by AI agents that understand creative intent, capture every note, and can make changes live. Unlike Zoom or Google Meet, where context disappears when the call ends, Pactto rooms remember everything. Every conversation, every decision, every piece of feedback.

products.name: AgentScore
products.tagline: Daily score to see if your agent gets better
products.summaryZh: 每日评分，看你的智能体是否有所提升
products.descriptionZh: 将你的生产环境智能体接入 Latitude，即可获得涵盖结果、可靠性、成本、速度和安全性五个维度的质量评分。评分每日更新，让你随时掌握智能体是在进步还是退步。
products.description: Connect your production agent to Latitude and get a quality score across outcome, reliability, cost, speed, and safety. It updates daily, so you always know whether your agent is improving or getting worse.

products.name: ToneBird
products.tagline: AI reply assistant that remembers your relationships
products.summaryZh: 能记住你人际关系的AI回复助手
products.descriptionZh: ToneBird 是一款适用于 Mac 和 Windows 的 AI 回复助手。它能记住你的人际关系，利用对话历史和关联文件，在 Gmail、Slack 及其他支持的应用程序中，以你的语气起草回复。你负责审阅和发送。
products.description: ToneBird is an AI reply assistant for Mac and Windows. It remembers your relationships, uses conversation history and connected files, and drafts replies in your voice inside Gmail, Slack, and other supported apps. You review and send.

products.name: Alexandria by Firecrawl
products.tagline: The knowledge library for superintelligence
products.summaryZh: 超级智能的知识库
products.descriptionZh: 通过一个连接，让AI代理直接访问数据提供商、专业索引和完整数据集。使用Alexandria的AI代理在答案质量上比使用内置网络工具高出21%。可通过Firecrawl的MCP、CLI和API使用。
products.description: Give AI agents direct access to data providers, specialized indexes and entire datasets through one connection. AI agents with Alexandria scored 21% higher on answer quality than with built-in web tools. Available through Firecrawl’s MCP, CLI and API.

products.name: Lightmeter
products.tagline: Film Camera designed for everyday moments
products.summaryZh: 为日常瞬间设计的胶片相机
products.descriptionZh: 带胶片时，它是真正的测光表；不带胶片时，它就是一台胶片相机。胶片质感基于真正的 RAW 捕捉——颗粒、光晕和色彩都像胶片一样表现，而不是在平淡照片上套滤镜。没有 AI，没有账号，任何数据都不会离开你的手机。
products.description: A real light meter when you carry film, and a film camera when you don't. Film looks built on true RAW capture - grain, halation and color that behave like film, not a filter on a flat photo. No AI, no account, nothing leaves your phone.

products.name: Dub Program Marketplace
products.tagline: Browse and apply to the best SaaS affiliate programs
products.summaryZh: 浏览并申请最佳SaaS联盟计划
products.descriptionZh: 浏览并申请最佳 SaaS 联盟计划，立即开始将你的受众变现。汇聚 Wispr Flow、Framer、Granola、Superhuman、CodeRabbit 等世界级公司。
products.description: Browse and apply to the best SaaS affiliate programs and start monetizing your audience today. Featuring world-class companies like Wispr Flow, Framer, Granola, Superhuman, CodeRabbit, and more.

products.name: RankControl
products.tagline: Get Cited by ChatGPT & Ranked on Google
products.summaryZh: 被ChatGPT引用并在Google上获得排名
products.descriptionZh: 大多数 AI SEO 工具只告诉你哪里提到了你，然后就止步了。RankControl 覆盖完整生命周期：创作出 AI 和 Google 都会推荐的内容，并以原生文章形式发布在你自己的域名上。追踪你在 ChatGPT、Perplexity、Claude、Gemini、Grok 等平台上的 AI 可见度，洞察竞争对手的缺口，获取外链，把文章转化为社交草稿，并查看分析数据和 AI 抓取报告。统一固定套餐，7 天免费试用。
products.description: Most AI SEO tools tell you where you're mentioned and stop. RankControl runs the full lifecycle: create content that AI and Google recommend, published as native posts on your own domain. Track your AI visibility across ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, Gemini, Grok, and more, spy on competitor gaps, earn backlinks, turn articles into social drafts, and check analytics and AI crawl reports. One flat plan, 7-day free trial.

products.name: GBrain
products.tagline: Garry Tan's AI memory, tools, & skills for any harness
products.summaryZh: Garry Tan 的 AI 记忆、工具和技能，适用于任何框架
products.descriptionZh: GBrain 为你提供一套记忆和一组互联账户，任何 AI 都能访问。在 Claude Code 中写一条笔记，ChatGPT 就能知道。连接一次 Gmail，Cursor 就能搜索它，无需在配置文件中放置密钥。记忆是一个 Markdown 文件文件夹，你可以阅读、修改并随身携带。可在你自己的推理服务或我们的服务上运行，位于整个团队共享的工作区中。团队工作区首月优惠 100 美元，详见 https://gbrain.io/gratis/product-hunt
products.description: GBrain gives you a memory and a set of connected accounts that every AI can reach. Write a note in Claude Code and ChatGPT knows it. Connect Gmail once and Cursor can search it with no key in a config file. The memory is a folder of markdown files you can read, correct and take with you. Run it on your own inference or ours, in a workspace your whole team shares. $100 off the first month for a team workspace at https://gbrain.io/gratis/product-hunt

products.name: Speechka
products.tagline: Real-time voice translation that sounds like you
products.summaryZh: 实时语音翻译，听起来就像你自己
products.descriptionZh: 自然说话。Speechka 实时翻译你的语音，并以你自己的声音用 44 种语言传达。可在 macOS 或 Windows 上用于会议、通话、直播、演示和大会。也可直接在浏览器中免费体验完整功能，无需安装。
products.description: Speak naturally. Speechka translates your speech in real time and delivers it in your own voice across 44 languages. Use it for meetings, calls, livestreams, presentations, and conferences on macOS or Windows. Or try the full experience directly in your browser for free, with no installation required.

products.name: Jev State
products.tagline: Turn AI conversations into tests and runnable code
products.summaryZh: 将 AI 对话转化为测试和可运行代码
products.descriptionZh: 使用 Jev 构建并测试对话工作流。了解每一步为何发生，将对话保存为测试，在上线前发现错误走向。导出可运行的 TypeScript、工作流 JSON，以及供编码代理使用的集成技能。免费且开源。实时运行需自备密钥。
products.description: Build and test conversational workflows with Jev. See why each step happened, save conversations as tests, and catch wrong turns before you ship. Export runnable TypeScript, workflow JSON, and an integration skill for your coding agent. Free and open source. Bring your own key for live runs.

products.name: Koreshield
products.tagline: Security and evidence for AI support agents
products.summaryZh: AI支持代理的安全与证据
products.descriptionZh: 每个AI支持代理都会从它本不应信任的来源接收输入：客户消息、检索到的文档以及提议的工具调用。Koreshield在它们成为受信任的模型行为或应用执行之前，对这三者进行筛查。数据泄露、帮助文章中的隐藏指令、策略偏移和不安全的代理操作，都会在模型行动前被检查，并且每个决策都会被记录。一次调用即可集成。
products.description: Every AI support agent takes input from someone it should not trust: the customer message, the documents it retrieves, and the tool calls it proposes. Koreshield screens all three before they become trusted model behavior or application execution. Data leaks, hidden instructions in help articles, policy drift and unsafe agent actions are checked before the model acts, and every decision is recorded. One call to integrate.

products.name: Linguo Translate
products.tagline: Offline & AI Translation for macOS
products.summaryZh: macOS 离线与 AI 翻译
products.descriptionZh: Linguo 是一款位于 macOS 菜单栏的翻译工具。你可以通过菜单栏图标进行翻译，支持 22 种语言的离线翻译，也可以使用 Apple Intelligence、Gemini、OpenAI 或 Anthropic 进行 AI 翻译。它让你可以轻松在原生翻译和 AI 翻译之间切换。
products.description: Linguo is a translator located in the macOS menu bar. You can translate using the menu bar icon with offline support for 22 languages or use AI translation with Apple Intelligence, Gemini, OpenAI, or Anthropic. It allows you to switch easily between native translations and AI translations.

products.name: CodeSpotlight
products.tagline: Make your code impossible to miss.
products.summaryZh: 让你的代码无法被忽视。
products.descriptionZh: CodeSpotlight 通过可自定义的动画效果，让选中的代码在 IntelliJ IDEA 中视觉上脱颖而出。专为编程 YouTuber、导师、讲师、课程创作者、直播主、技术演示者以及任何希望代码引人注目的人打造。
products.description: CodeSpotlight makes selected code visually stand out in IntelliJ IDEA with customizable animated effects. Built for coding YouTubers, tutors, instructors, course creators, livestreamers, technical presenters, and anyone who wants their code to be impossible to miss.

products.name: Rumora
products.tagline: Place your product in comments on videos going viral
products.summaryZh: 在热门视频的评论区留下你的产品信息
products.descriptionZh: Rumora 将你的产品置于你所在领域正在走红的视频评论区，依托一个最多 50,000 个账号的网络。你无需制作视频、购买广告或关联自己的个人资料。一条听起来像真实用户的首评。持续推动讨论的回复。点赞，让它停留在人们阅读的位置。TikTok、YouTube，很快还将支持 Instagram。专为不愿出镜、没有广告预算的白手起家者打造。预览版免费：领取 500 积分，我们为你埋下第一个传闻。
products.description: Rumora places your product in the comments of videos going viral in your niche, from a network of up to 50,000 accounts. You do not make the video, buy the ad, or connect your own profiles. A first comment that sounds like a real user. Replies that keep the thread going. Upvotes so it sits where people read. TikTok, YouTube, and soon Instagram. Built for bootstrappers shy of camera and with no ad budget. Free in preview: claim 500 credits and we plant the first rumor for you.

products.name: IconsDB
products.tagline: AI powered search across 200K+ free icons.
products.summaryZh: AI 驱动的搜索，覆盖 20 万+ 免费图标。
products.descriptionZh: 别再猜图标名称了。描述你的需求（如“悲伤的机器人”“钱在流失”），即可从 Lucide、Heroicons、Phosphor、Material 等 80 多个图标集、超过 20 万个图标中即时找到。可复制为 SVG、React、Vue 或 CSS。
products.description: Stop guessing icon names. Describe what you need ("sad robot," "money leaving") and find it instantly across 200K+ icons from Lucide, Heroicons, Phosphor, Material and 80 more sets. Copy as SVG, React, Vue or CSS.

products.name: Nimply
products.tagline: Hire AI agents that run your social media - you approve
products.summaryZh: 雇佣运行你社交媒体的AI代理——由你审批
products.descriptionZh: Nimply 是一支 AI 社交媒体工作团队。你可以从智能体库中按需选用：支持回复、线索获取、内容审核、代笔撰写、轮播图制作、内容再利用和趋势追踪。这些智能体运行在一个完整平台之上，平台配有可发布至 9 个网络的规划器、统一收件箱和可视化自动化画布。关键规则是：智能体负责起草，由你审批。未经你许可，它们无法发布。免费方案，无需绑定信用卡。付费方案每月 9.99 美元起。包含 iOS、Android、浏览器扩展、公开 API 和 MCP 服务器。
products.description: Nimply is an AI social media workforce. Hire agents from a gallery: support replies, lead capture, moderation, ghostwriting, carousels, repurposing and trend scouting. They work on top of a full platform, with a planner publishing to 9 networks, a unified inbox and a visual automation canvas. The rule that matters: agents draft, you approve. They cannot publish without you. Free plan, no card. Paid from $9.99/mo. iOS, Android, browser extension, public API and MCP server included.

products.name: blognice
products.tagline: Simple, privacy-first blogging you truly own
products.summaryZh: 简单、隐私优先、真正属于你的博客
products.descriptionZh: Blognice 是一个简单、隐私优先的平台，可用于运行一个或多个博客，无需 WordPress 维护、平台锁定或复杂的发布工具。从一个账户管理所有博客，连接自定义域名，发布无限文章，并保留对内容和数据的所有权。可使用托管服务，或自行托管开源核心。
products.description: Blognice is a simple, privacy-first platform for running one or multiple blogs without WordPress maintenance, platform lock-in, or complicated publishing tools. Manage every blog from one account, connect custom domains, publish unlimited posts, and retain ownership of your content and data. Use the hosted service or self-host the open-source core.
